name: MOONYOLK
source:
MOONYOLK is a short tale about two boys 

floating in the sea and watching a lonely moon.  

A reminder that it's never too late to say you love me. 

[From [url=https://xiri.itch.io/moonyolk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于两个男孩的短篇故事：他们漂浮在海面上，凝望着孤独的月亮。

提醒你，向我说出“我爱你”永远不算太迟。

[来源：[url=https://xiri.itch.io/moonyolk]Itch.io[/url]]
